title: now_millis/now_secs .unwrap() on SystemTime
description: api.rs:49-51, api.rs:57-59, delivery.rs:40, push.rs:104-106, pixelfed_api.rs:78-79,91-92, cli.rs:514,596,672,706,720,786,813,867,1034, cards.rs:165. Throughout the codebase, SystemTime::now().duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH).unwrap() is used to get the current timestamp. While SystemTime::now() is always after UNIX_EPOCH on supported platforms (the api.rs comment acknowledges this), this pattern appears in at least 15 locations. The api.rs versions have a justifying comment, but the copies in other modules (delivery.rs:40, push.rs:105, pixelfed_api.rs, cli.rs etc.) do not. These should all call crate::api::now_millis() or crate::api::now_secs() to centralize the invariant and its comment.
